title: Foreign provider and Macrospace boundary
summary: Macrospace provides live Python objects while Maths remains numerical authority and Photo World remains reconstruction authority.
invariants: No subprocess/JSON substitute for the live object model.
Maths-owned objects may cross live into Python; Python need not invent a competing tensor/matrix authority.
OpenCV LSD currently returns only primitive straight-segment observations.
Depth Anything V2 may supply soft depth evidence only.
GeoCLIP may supply geographic candidates only.
PyMeshLab may process candidate meshes only.

provenance.claim: Qualified live-object crossing and provider boundary.
